title: Player Faction V2 Selection UI Foundation

context.previous_decision: Balanced battle testing for Team Synergies V2 is deferred to pre-release/balance QA.
context.reason: Current enemies are placeholders and too weak; meaningful balance requires real early/mid/endgame curves, credible enemy teams, PvP comparable teams, and all major buff systems available.
context.current_branch: Move to player identity/account foundation: Player Faction V2.

primary: Use existing PLAYER_FACTION_DEFINITIONS_V2 as source of truth if present
Show faction identity, description, visual identity, and future benefits
Add safe entry point from profile/menu/account area
Prepare free 1x faction change token concept
optional_if_low_risk: Add gated POST /api/user/faction-v2/select only if implementation is safe and backed up
out_of_scope: No battle bonuses from faction selection
No synergy buffs from faction selection

source_of_truth.fallback: If the existing schema differs, inspect and adapt. Do not invent final faction list blindly.
source_of_truth.expected_existing_note: RM1.23-A audit found PLAYER_FACTION_DEFINITIONS_V2 with 13 entries: 8 onboarding + 5 internal, all disabled/foundation at that time.

ui.title: Fazione del Giocatore
ui.subtitle: Scegli l'identità mitologica del tuo account.

entry_points.label: Scegli Fazione
entry_points.note: Only prepare route; do not force registration flow unless safe.

not_selected.description: User has no selected faction yet.
not_selected.warning: La scelta iniziale è importante, ma sarà disponibile 1 cambio gratuito.

selected.change_rule: 1 free faction change token concept, not monetized in this task.

locked_or_future.description: Faction option is internal/future, displayed locked or hidden depending schema.

visual_direction: no fake text baked into images

selection_rules.initial_selection: Allowed when user has no selected faction.
selection_rules.free_change_token: User should conceptually have 1 free change. Implement storage only if low-risk and explicit.
selection_rules.after_free_change: Future paid/event/rare token, not implemented now.
selection_rules.not_pay_to_win: Faction choice should be identity/community first; no immediate combat power in this task.
selection_rules.pre_release_note: Future faction bonuses/events can be added after core systems stabilize.

backend.preferred_strategy: start with read-only endpoints and UI. Add selection POST only if clearly safe.

requirements: one free change token if present/implicit

storage_suggestion.users.faction_change_tokens: integer, default 1 if missing if write endpoint implemented

borea_policy.notes: Player faction task must not affect Borea hidden/pending status or legacy Borea.

acceptance_criteria: Faction list is loaded from existing PLAYER_FACTION_DEFINITIONS_V2 or safely adapted endpoint.
If selection write endpoint is implemented, it only touches current user document and is guarded.
No DB writes if the task is implemented as read-only foundation.
No TypeScript errors in modified files.
